chapters.content:
The Summer I Turned Pretty is a contemporary work by Jenny Han (2009).

Belly measures her life in summers at Cousins Beach with brothers Conrad and Jeremiah Fisher in this beloved coming-of-age romance.

Categorized under: YA, Romance, Coming-of-age.
